_noteP: Doom'n Gloom, re-verified: GloomProcCalc (VexPAbility/VexP) = ByCharLevelInterpolation(StartValue=40, EndValue=150) + StatByNamedDataValue(APRatio=0.25, default stat AP). Unchanged from the prior pass's hand-trace (L1=40, L9 (t=(9-1)/17=0.4706) = 40+110*0.4706=91.8, L18=150, + 25% AP). Curated as a P bonusEffect trigger onAbility (unchanged). ADDED CAVEAT this pass: per the live-wiki text, the Gloom mark is APPLIED by proximity dash/blink detection or by E (Looming Darkness) hitting a target, and is CONSUMED for this bonus damage specifically by 'Vex's next basic attack, Mistral Bolt (Q), or Personal Space (W)' against the marked target -- R is not documented as a consumer, and E is the applier rather than (typically) a consumer of its own mark. The existing onAbility trigger (this project's only 'fires on an ability cast' primitive) necessarily applies to ALL of Q/W/E/R uniformly, which is broader than the real Q/W/basic-attack-only consumption rule -- an approximation carried over unchanged from the prior pass, now explicitly flagged here rather than silently assumed correct. MonsterCap-style caps and the Fear/Slow crowd-control amplification the passive grants to other abilities remain out of scope (CC modifiers, not separate damage instances).
_noteP_appliesTo: APPLIES-TO CURATED (loop 476, user report that P was riding E and R). _noteR: Shadow Surge. TWO structurally separate BIN calcs, both under VexRAbility/VexR (RecastDamageCalc is also duplicated under VexRAbility/VexR2, same values -- the VexR copy is used here): (1) RDamageCalc = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage) + StatByCoefficient(0.2 => AP) -- the initial Shadow dash hitting all enemies in its path (live-wiki: '75 / 125 / 175 (+ 20% AP) magic damage to all enemies hit'). (2) RecastDamageCalc = NamedDataValue(RecastDamage) + StatByCoefficient(0.5 => AP) -- the RECAST, which pulls Vex to the single marked target and consumes the mark for a separate, larger hit (live-wiki: 'Recast: ... dealing them 150 / 250 / 350 (+ 50% AP) magic damage'). Modeled as two hits within one R slot/cast (not castCount, since these are two DIFFERENT formulas/targets, not repeats of the same hit) -- consistent with this project's existing multi-different-hit precedent (e.g. Ahri Q's Magic+True split). Tagged BurstCeiling: the combined R1+R2 total is Vex's single highest realistic burst-damage contribution (her execute-style ultimate combo finisher), matching the champion's build-around-ult identity.
